programme.title: Jejaka Perasan
programme.desc: Dolah dan Dolit, masing-masing telah dihalau dari rumah oleh ibu dan isteri kerana malas bekerja dan gemar bermain judi kuda. Mereka pun menyewa bilik di rumah Pak Wok. Pak Wok tinggal bersama anaknya Rizan yang sedang bercinta dengan Amir. Mereka ditawarkan bekerja sebagai tukang cuci oleh Dato Kamarul kerana telah membantu membaiki kereta anaknya, Dora. Mulalah tersebar cerita bahawa mereka merupakan pegawai tetapi sebenarnya tidak.

programme.title: Anak Niat
programme.desc: Juita dipanggil anak niat yang ditatah penuh kasih sayang oleh ibu dan bapanya, Orang Kaya dan Faridah. Ibu dan bapa Juita bernazar kepada Keramat untuk mendapatkan seorang anak iaitu Juita namun tidak mahu menerima kenyataan bahawa perbuatan itu adalah syirik. Juita kemudian menjalinkan hubungan bersama Jidot. Abang Mat pula sedih kerana sering dipandang hina oleh Orang Kaya dan Juita hanya kerana dia seorang pembantu yang diupah oleh mereka. Kebenaran terbongkar apabila Abang Mat ialah bapa kepada Jidot dan juga Juita.

programme.title: Bintang Pujaan
programme.desc: Rina dan Hassan mencintai antara satu sama lain namun hubungan mereka mulai retak. Ini kerana Rina ingin meneruskan kerjayanya sebagai seorang penyanyi dan pelakon. Hassan pula mendapat kerja baru di syarikat pembinaan milik Nancy. Percintaan Rina dan Hassan kembali mekar dan mereka pun berkahwin. Namun, satu insiden yang menimpa Hassan telah mengubah hidup mereka.

programme.title: Pagar-Pagar Cinta
programme.desc: Pelbagai rintangan terpaksa dihadapi Bidin dan Ani kerana cinta antara dua darjat. Bidin, anak orang kaya manakala Ani hanyalah seorang yang biasa-biasa sahaja. Ibu Bidin ingin menjodohkannya dengan Rita, anak kepada kenalannya yang kaya-raya. Berbagai cara terpaksa dilakukan oleh Bidin untuk menyakinkan bahawa Ani lah pilihan hatinya. Berjayakah rancangan Bidin untuk melembutkan hati ibunya?

programme.title: Memori
programme.desc: Seorang Dato yang berpengaruh bersama dua orang anaknya yang mempunyai masalah tersendiri. Anaknya, Ogy bergelut dengan dunia dadah manakala Nash, terlampau menyukai dunia permotoran sehingga obses akan perkara itu. Kehilangan bapa mereka akhirnya menimbulkan rasa sesal dalam diri Ogy dan Nash.

programme.title: Bertunang
programme.desc: Darus ingin dikahwini dengan Zarinah, anak pengurus bank oleh bapa saudaranya - dia merupakan seorang yang kaya-raya. Namun, Darus melarikan diri kerana dia enggan mengahwini Zarinah dan sudah mempunyai kekasih hati. Mengetahui tujuan bapa saudaranya ingin menjodohkannya bersama anak seorang pengurus bank untuk membiayai projeknya, Darus hilang membawa diri - tetapi bapa saudaranya mempunyai rancangannya yang tersendiri.

programme.title: Penghujung Malam
programme.desc: Razak yang telah merantau membawa diri setelah rumahtangganya runtuh kira-kira 15 tahun yang lalu telah kembali ke Malaysia. Niatnya hanya satu, mahu membina semula rumahtangganya dan memastikan anaknya Rita yang kini berusia 19 tahun dan merupakan seorang penyanyi terkenal mendapat kasih sayang seorang bapa. Malangnya, bekas isteri dan anaknya itu tidak mahu menerima Razak malah menaruh perasaan benci yang amat sangat terhadap dirinya.

programme.title: Bayi Tabung
programme.desc: Setelah mengharungi satu peristiwa yang menghimpit kehidupan, Jelina ditawarkan untuk menyewakan rahimnya dengan bayaran tinggi oleh sepasang suami isteri dari Malaysia yang tidak punya anak secara biasa. Tawaran harga yang tinggi membuatkan Jelina bersetuju untuk menerima titipan embrio itu sehingga lahir. Setelah bayi itu lahir timbul pula satu masalah kerana Jelina merasa bahawa bayi itu adalah darah dagingnya.

programme.title: Bisikan Remaja
programme.desc: Ameera yang baru berpindah dari Sabah ke Kuala Lumpur bersekolah di kolej swasta, dan dipilih sebagai ketua kelas. Rakan-rakan Daniel bagaimanapun merasakan bahawa Daniel, sebagai ahli sukan kolej, lebih layak untuk jawatan itu. Ketidakpuasan hati ini memecahkan kelas kepada dua puak. Ameera semakin popular kerana kecantikan, kecerdasan dan personalitinya. Daniel membuat taruhan dengan rakan-rakannya, bahawa dia akan dapat memenangi hati Ameera dalam masa dua minggu. Apabila Ameera mengetahui tentang pertaruhan itu, dia dan Daniel menjadi musuh, walaupun telah membina perasaan bersama antara satu sama lain.

programme.title: Suci Dalam Debu

Tengku Johan ingin mempercepatkan tarikh perkahwinan mereka kerana ingin memiliki Rina. Roy telah dicabar dan diletakkan taruhan oleh Tengku Johan jika benar dia boleh mendapatkan Rina.

Selepas diculik dan kehilangan neneknya, dia dipersalahkan dan dihalau oleh keluarganya. Dengan semangat dan keimanan yang teguh, Saleha memulakan hidup baru di Jakarta sambil menyembunyikan penyakit serius.

programme.title: Jarang Online Tapi On My Heart
programme.desc: Nada Masaji Wijayanto meninggalkan rumah, dan Melody Larasati Nugroho merasa keliru tentang apa yang harus dilakukan untuk menyelamatkan rumah tangganya. Melody kemudian pergi berjumpa bomoh. Tanpa ragu, Melody meminta agar dia dapat menukar Nada dengan seseorang yang lebih baik dan juga ingin kembali ke masa lalu. Walaupun kesal, bomoh tersebut akhirnya menuruti permintaan Melody dan mula membaca mantera, sehingga Melody terperangkap dalam portal waktu dan dibawa ke masa lalu.

programme.title: Jangan Spam Cinta di Hatiku
programme.desc: Mika mempunyai seorang kekasih yang tampan, namun dia sering beremosi, yang membuat Mika sangat kesal. Contohnya, pada suatu hari hujan, kekasihnya marah kerana Mika memilih untuk menaiki motosikal dan enggan masuk ke dalam kereta, sehingga mereka tidak dapat meneruskan perjalanan. Akhirnya, Mika memutuskan hubungan dengan kekasihnya, yang membuatnya merasa terluka dan berusaha untuk tampil sebaik mungkin setelah putus! Dia bertekad untuk tampil lebih menarik. Tak lama kemudian, Mika bertemu dengan seorang penjual gula-gula kapas tampan yang tiba-tiba membuatnya kesal, kerana penjual itu berkata bahawa Mika mudah beremosi dan sering berprasangka buruk terhadap orang lain!

programme.title: Salingka Bumi Minang
programme.desc: Dokumentari separa realiti yang meneroka Minang, sebuah wilayah di Indonesia yang terkenal sebagai Tanah Para Pedagang.

programme.title: Wanita Istimewa
programme.desc: Mirsa Alisia Rininta dan Radit Reuben Elishama hidup sederhana di Padang sehingga satu kesilapan besar berlaku apabila Radit tanpa sedar membawa beg berisi dadah. Untuk melindungi suaminya, Mirsa menyerah diri dan dipenjara selama tujuh tahun, manakala bayi yang dilahirkannya terpaksa diserahkan kepada ibu mertuanya untuk dijaga. Selepas dibebaskan, Mirsa mencari keluarganya tetapi mendapati Radit sudah berpindah ke Jakarta. Jejak itu membawa Mirsa ke sebuah acara pelancaran perumahan di mana dia bertemu semula dengan Radit yang kini bersama isterinya Karina Naomi Zaskia dan berkenalan dengan Reza Randy Pangalila, sementara tekanan daripada Pramana Adipura terhadap perkahwinan mereka mula terbongkar.

programme.title: Indonesia Pintar
programme.desc: Rancangan permainan terbesar di Indonesia yang mempertandingkan kecerdasan dan kecekapan 100 pelajar sekolah. Program ini diisi dengan pelbagai permainan menarik dan hadiah keseluruhan bernilai jutaan rupiah.

programme.title: Jejak Misteri
programme.desc: Jejak Misteri ialah sebuah rancangan realiti bergenre misteri di mana setiap episod menyajikan liputan pelbagai tempat, bangunan dan tapak bersejarah yang bukan sahaja menyimpan kisah-kisah bersejarah, malah turut meninggalkan kisah-kisah mistik.

programme.title: Pelangi Untuk Nirmala
programme.desc: Persahabatan antara dua orang gadis, Pelangi dan Nirmala. Namun, persahabatan mereka ditentang oleh orang tua mereka kerana perbezaan strata sosial. Pelangi hidup dengan sederhana, sementara Nirmala hidup mewah.

programme.title: Cinta Setelah Cinta
programme.desc: Starla menyangka dia telah menghadapi segalanya, tetapi penipuan Niko jauh lebih mendalam daripada yang disangkanya. Ketika dia terus berusaha mempertahankan perkahwinannya, ancaman baharu muncul. Ayu, yang masih taksub dengan Niko, semakin mengikatnya dalam perangkap dengan menggunakan anak mereka yang belum lahir sebagai umpan. Pada masa yang sama, naluri Starla merasakan ada sesuatu yang tidak kena, dan dia mula diburu oleh bayang-bayang serta rahsia gelap. Dengan keluarganya di ambang bahaya dan emosinya semakin tertekan, adakah Starla mampu melindungi orang-orang tersayang? Atau adakah pengkhianatan Niko akan mendorongnya melangkaui batas yang tidak boleh kembali?

programme.title: DR. CHEON AND THE LOST TALISMAN
programme.desc: Dr. Cheon is a fake exorcist who cannot see or hear any ghosts. One day, a woman comes to Dr. Cheon, asking him to save her possessed younger sister.

programme.title: UNFORGETTABLE

programme.desc: Joo Sang-sook, who failed to win the Seoul mayoral election by dropping the truth bomb on national television, is suddenly pulled into the spotlight again after rescuing a young man from drowning.

programme.desc: After his brother Seok-tae returns as a bloody corpse, Min-tae discovers the death of his brother was foretold in a novel, and Seok-taes wife had a suspicious call with the novelist...

programme.title: Vital Lifeline
programme.desc: Urban dwellers often experience a hectic pace of life and high levels of stress, making them more susceptible to health problems. The Strongest Lifeline helps you unravel the secrets to good health. To start, the program features a four-episode series on common urban pain issues, covering headaches, shoulder and neck pain, back pain, and joint pain. Each episode invites medical experts to explain the causes of these conditions, as well as physical therapists and exercise specialists to teach appropriate exercises. With the growing trend of integrating Eastern and Western medicine, even American swimming champion Michael Phelps uses cupping therapy to relieve pain. Therefore, each episode also includes traditional Chinese medical diagnosis, complemented by treatments such as acupuncture, cupping, and the Sanfu herbal patch therapy, which is especially suitable during the hottest days of summer. In addition, Chinese medicine practitioners share recipes for nourishing soups, all of which can help regulate and improve your health.

programme.desc: Hong Kong life is vibrant and diverse, and Hong Kong Life, Hong Kong Enjoyment presents both sophisticated and elegant lifestyles and down-to-earth, high-quality experiences. The program combines diverse themes, exploring different areas in each episode and inviting elites from various industries to share their secrets to success.

programme.title: News At 18:30
programme.desc: Jade Channel reports important local, cross-strait, and international news every afternoon at 6:30.

programme.title: News Magazine 2026 Yes, Boss.

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: Scoop airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: My Family Legacy II
programme.desc: Children take different paths at each stage of life, and parents want to be their strongest support. Is The Family Tradition of Protection an important part of this? Big Brother Sammo Hung founded the Hung Clan, and his son, Timmy Hung, continues his fathers legacy, contributing to the promotion of martial arts films and hoping to pass it on to his son, Hung Tai-yan. Alex Fong inherited his fathers swimming talent, becoming an Olympic swimmer before transitioning to acting and opening a swimming school though the stage may change, the Fong familys beliefs remain unchanged! Liu Yingxuan, raised abroad, has achieved a confident and beautiful life thanks to her parents dedicated nurturing. In this video, she washes and dyes her fathers hair, a former hairstylist, sharing a heartwarming story of father-daughter affection.

programme.title: Music Money Monster
programme.desc: Pushing the limits of vocal range and precise timing, the brand-new interactive music game show Music Money Monster is hosted by Sammy, Eric Kwok, and Lee Yin-tung. A professional pitch analysis system tests the contestants. A nine-square grid represents nine difficulty levels. Contestants who connect three lines to pass the level can choose to withdraw their winnings, continue the challenge, or even attempt the most difficult Monster level. Failure results in zero prize money! The amateur version allows solo participants to compete for a top prize of NT100,000. The celebrity version offers viewers a chance to win prizes and gifts by interacting with the contestants in the live stream and sending emojis to cheer them on.

programme.title: J Music 2026
programme.desc: J Music is dedicated to creating a high-quality music platform, providing singers with opportunities to showcase their musical talents while allowing music fans to gain a deeper understanding of their musical stories. The program invites popular singers as guests, who personally select their favorite new and old works, perform them live, and share their favorite tracks. New faces in the music scene will also appear, showcasing their musical potential through interactive exchanges. Furthermore, each episode closely follows the latest developments on the Jade Solid Gold Chart, featuring music videos and interviews with various singers, songwriters, and producers, who discuss their work and the people and events within the music industry.

programme.title: Gourmet Express Weekly
programme.desc: Hong Kong is a melting pot of global cuisine! Food anchors and hosts like Carmaney Wong,Carmen Ngai,Gillian Ng stay up-to-date with the latest culinary trends, gathering information on top-rated restaurants from various platforms. The hosts personally sample the food and provide honest reviews they uncover hidden gems in different districts and invite long-time expatriates to visit their favorite hometown eateries renowned chefs and food critics also guide the way, offering expert recommendations. The program features a selection of popular restaurants featured in Food News Report, highlighting their signature dishes and delivering quick deals, ensuring viewers stay up-to-date with the most delicious and affordable dining information.

programme.title: Thai Rogered Sr.11
programme.desc: Thailand expert Hu Huichong once again leads the Tom Yum Family members to introduce the latest travel information in Bangkok, including glamorous massage parlors with perfect photo spots, newly opened shopping malls with sky parks, and buffet restaurants hailed as the pinnacle of Bangkok tourism. The content is truly rich in Thai elements. In addition, Bobo Huang Jingling continues to appear in this episode, giving away plenty of perks. She will accompany Hu Huichong to visit Ayutthaya, Khao Yai, and other areas around Bangkok, recommending popular holiday destinations for locals. Besides unboxing hotels, they will also visit pseudo-Japanese photo spots and hotel-attached childrens playgrounds, guaranteeing an authentic Thai experience.

programme.title: The Joy Of Nature
programme.desc: Taiwans camping destinations are breathtaking! Hong Kong host Lin Yinghui, along with three of Taiwans goddesses Lin Xiang, Zhang Yahan, and Huang Shangyan, embarked on a nature-themed healing trip. They traversed Nantou, Kaohsiung, Taoyuan, and other locations, delving into the Miaoli mountains, trying out forest cabins, luxury campervans, deluxe tents, and even camping at a baseball stadium Surrounded by mountains, they enjoyed open-air hot springs, watched the sunset at the beach, explored historical sites near the campsites, and immersed themselves in nature. Finally, they returned to Yangmingshan in Taipei for camping, soaking in hot springs, and overlooking the unparalleled night view of Taipei! Besides experiencing the unique atmosphere of camping, what sparks will fly between the Taiwanese and Hong Kong women as they interact and bond?

programme.title: Blessing of Formosa
programme.desc: The beauty of folklore is all around us in Taiwan, but we often overlook it and fail to appreciate and feel it. The aim of this program is to promote the beauty of Taiwanese folklore and bring folklore to life. This program showcases folk culture regardless of race or religion, and presents travel information in a fun way, combining easy-to-understand folk culture knowledge with the mission of passing on folk culture. The audience can learn more about folk cultural products such as handicrafts, antiques, temple folklore, as well as short stories about the gods, and information about local tourism. It is an educational and entertaining way to travel and learn about folklore.

programme.title: All Suspects
programme.desc: A policeman on leave checks into a BB, sharing the space with a detective novelist, a homeless drifter and a pianist. However, when the owner and the receptionist are found dead, the peaceful retreat turns into a web of suspicion and deceit. Each guest becomes both suspect and sleutheach guarding a secret that could unravel the entire mystery.

programme.title: Hail the Judge
programme.desc: A low level magistrate is run out of town for defending a beautiful murder suspect. Through a series of comedic events he ascends to the top rank returns looking for revenge.

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In Hong Kong
programme.desc: This is a story of ICAC investigators fighting against rampant corruption in early 1970s Hong Kong. A police sergeant teams up with a triad boss to make billions of dollars in bribes. As a lawyer joins his friend in ICAC to investigate their collusion and fight against corruption, the battle between the righteous and the wicked has just begun.

programme.title: Love is the only Answer
programme.desc: At Bo and Cheong wedding reception, the projected was initially showing their journey of love, but suddenly a flash of a clip of Cheong and a sexy girl being intimate came up. Bo calmly ran up to the stage and announced that the wedding is cancelled. The incident rapidly became a hot topic on the internet. Within a year, back to being single again, Bo and the living life happily Cheong maintains a good relationship. One day, Cheong decided to play with love and took Bo to participate in a swinging party. The conservative Bo initially wanted to leave, but after being bribed by Cheong, she helpless and stayed. At the swinging party, the two encounter Kit and his wife Man Lai. The 4 of them develop a romantic and hot relationship... At another wedding reception, when the projector plays the groom and brides heartwarming clips, a flash of another clip that does not want to be seen comes up...

programme.title: Wolf Pack
programme.desc: The Wolf Pack squad led by Lao Diao, is a foreign-based team that specializes in overseas security jobs. In one of the missions, the squad discovers that a terrorist force is planning to destroy the countrys energy source. Lao Diao is now entrusted with the task of leading his squad to fight back. Can the Wolf Pack save the day?

programme.title: Another Me
programme.desc: Constable Li Mao marries a rich girl but her parents disapprove of their marriage. One day, Li accidentally discovers that he looks exactly like the prince! While he aims to secure a high ranking position in the palace, the prince wants freedom, so they decide to switch identities. This however, got them both involved in the ministers conspiracy

programme.title: Blades of the Guardians
programme.desc: Fugitive bounty hunter Dao Ma takes on a perilous escort mission across the desert to Changan. His charge is the empires most wanted man, drawing pursuit from all sides. As rival forces close in, Dao Ma is pulled into a conspiracy that threatens war between the imperial court and the martial world.

programme.title: Golden Boy
programme.desc: After a decade in prison, former boxer Cheung Lek meets his son for the first time. Forced to live together for an inheritance, the estranged pair struggles to rebuild trust. As Cheung Lek returns to the ring for one last shot at redemption, he must confront his past and fight for a future with his son.

programme.title: The Lychee Road
programme.desc: A single lychee sparks a Tang Dynasty Mission Impossible! Low-ranking official Li Shan De must deliver it a thousand miles in three days to satisfy a consorts craving. Racing against time, he encounters obstacles and absurd demands, turning the journey into a satirical adventure filled with tension and unexpected twists.

programme.title: Old Fox
programme.desc: In 1989, young Liao Jie and his father save for a home, unaware of rising property prices. Frustrated by poverty, he learns from their landlord Old Fox who teaches him survival in society. Liao Jie ends up hurting Old Fox with what he has learnt, but his empathy prevents him from becoming like Old Fox.

programme.title: Schemes in Antiques
programme.desc: Despite his familys expertise in ancient Chinese relics, Xu Yuan becomes an electronics shop owner to distance himself from his disgraced family. However, when an antique is to be returned to China, Xu Yuan uncovers an ancient mystery and soon embarks on a journey that can finally restore his familys reputation but may also cost him his life.

programme.title: Montages of a Modern Motherhood
programme.desc: Shu Zhens life takes a sharp downturn after the birth of her daughter. Exhausted by the demands of caring for a newborn and neglected by her indifferent husband, she finds herself caught in growing family conflicts, postnatal turmoil, and unyielding work stress. Through long and lonely nights, will the dawn bring her hope or despair?

programme.title: Wolf Hiding
programme.desc: A cold-blooded killer, Chen An vows to take revenge for her sister who was killed by a crime gang. Dealing with the police and the triad at the same time, a final battle between good and evil has just begun!

programme.title: Reincarnated Swordsman
programme.desc: A Wu Dang disciple Fu, kills the chief of Wu Dang Clan and frames it on the chiefs illegitimate child, Yun. Fu then proclaims himself the new chief and orders the killing of Yun, who vows to avenge his fathers death and learns the invincible silkworm martial arts style in order to defeat Fu.

programme.title: Return Of The Sentimental Swordsman
programme.desc: One of Shaw Studios highest grossing movies ever, this is the story of Li Chin Huan, the renowned, charming and sentimental swordsman who must fight many opponents, including an evil Clan Chief, for a place in the martial arts world.

programme.title: Mr. Funnybone Strikes Again
programme.desc: In this hilarious sequel, Mr Big Potato opens an old-fashioned Chinese clinic, but his traditional methods are rejected by the sceptics of modern Hong Kong. Enter his buddy Mr Funny bone to rescue his business!

programme.title: Lady Of Steel
programme.desc: A young swordswoman Fang Ying Qi sets out to join the Flying Dragon Clan in their defense against the invading Jin forces. Fang also intends to avenge the murder of her parents by bandit leader Han 20 years ago. Han has since taken on a false identity as a member of the Flying Dragon Clan and Fang must rely on her deadly sword skills to stop Han.

programme.title: Madam White Snake
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai is perfect as Pak Su-cheng, the stunning snake goddess who assumes a womanly form so that she can taste the pleasures of a human life! Pak seduces young scholar, Hsu Hsien when she recognises him as her saviour in another life 1,000 years ago. But when Buddhist monk Fa Hai finds out about the union, the pair is forced to split...

programme.title: Twelve Deadly Coins
programme.desc: When Qiao Miao is about to kill the bandit whom he just met, he is attracted by her beauty and they quickly fall in love. The two later discover the blood feud between the owner of the unique weapon - Twelve Deadly Coins and the old master who controls the bandit...

programme.title: Love Parade
programme.desc: Fashion designer Shi asks his friend Mui to comment on his new design but is angered by her criticism. When Mui asks him to design a gown for her to attend a gala event, Shi takes revenge by making a clown costume instead. Seeing Muis embarrassment, Shi feels guilty and apologizes to her, before they fall in love

programme.title: The Swordmates
programme.desc: Li asks his swordmate Wang to protect his family while he is away, but Wang rapes his wife and even has his convoy attacked. Li escaped but fears his daughter is still in danger, so he asks the nephew of his master to help protect her

programme.title: Moonlight Serenade
programme.desc: A sweet inn-keepers daughter is witness to a perverted rape, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle. Can her true love rescue her in time? For this movie, the moonlight serenade is the sound of suspense, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle.

programme.title: Killers Five
programme.desc: The Dukes daughter has been kidnapped by the notorious Golden Dragon Hill bandits. A swordman named Yue Zhen Bei is assigned to save her, and expecting many dangers on the journey, Yue garners help from a group of good friends who are also kung fu masters.

programme.title: Dawn Will Come
programme.desc: Liang Cai drugged the beautiful Qiu Rong and raped her, but promised to marry her after getting his parents consent. Since then, there is no news of his proposal and Qiu Rong confronts Liang Cai when she finds herself pregnant. This is when she discovers that he has already married a rich noble girl and even plans to kill her

programme.title: Call to Arms
programme.desc: The aggressive and dangerous Chin Empire conquers the hard-put Chao kingdom while the Wei empire is drained of its heroes and paralyzed by an indecisive ruler. Adventure, intrigue, death and tragedy reigns before the triumphant clash of the armies.

programme.title: Asia-pol
programme.desc: Asiapol agent Yang Ming Xuan trails a shipment of contraband gold being delivered to gang leader, George Eaton. He enlists the help of a Chinese woman who is trying to avenge her sister and narrowly escapes several deadly traps as he closes in on Eatons location. This spy film is loosely inspired by the James Bond movies.

programme.title: The Three Smiles
programme.desc: A talented scholar, Bo Hu, is attracted by the pretty maid, Qiu Xiang. In order to get close to her and win her love, he disguises as a servant to work in the same household. Qiu Xiang does not believe Bo Hu when he discloses his true identity to her, only falling in love with him when he reveals his talents and with his friends help.

programme.title: Arctic Secrets
programme.desc: The Hudson Bay lowlands are part of North Americas largest wetland. Over 300,000 square kilometers of muskeg, a vast bogland as far as the eye can see characterized by water soaked peat, mosses and stunted trees. Once thought of as barren wasteland, it is now understood that these bogs are crucially important to life on earth. Globally, there is as much carbon dioxide held in wetlands as there is in the atmosphere. The peatland ecosystem is the most efficient carbon sink on the planet.

programme.title: Extreme Africa
programme.desc: South Africas Drakensberg is one of the continents most impressive landscapes. It is home to sharp climatic and ecological gradients as physical conditions change for both land-based creatures and the Raptors that swirl in the skies above.

programme.title: Extreme Africa
programme.desc: In north Tanzania, towering mountains line a dramatic valley. Enriched by ancient volcanoes, its slopes provide a variety of habitats for life to thrive and its great centerpiece holds water through even the driest of times.

programme.title: Extreme Africa
programme.desc: Simien Mountains National Park in Ethiopia is home to some of the rarest creatures on earth. Take a glimpse into life on some of the highest peaks in Africa, in the last stronghold of shaggy, grass-grazing Geladas, elusive Simien wolves and horned Walia ibex.

programme.title: Extreme Africa
programme.desc: The Southern Drylands is a journey into the most arid and extreme environments in the furthest reaches of southern Africa. We go to spectacular but treacherous places where almost no rain falls, to find incredibly resilient creatures and learn the secrets to their survival. From the largest mammals to the fastest insects and even a ghost-like fish found nowhere else in the world, the Southern Drylands contain some extraordinary inhabitants, all connected by the daily challenges of living in some of most inhospitable habitats in the world.

programme.title: Extreme Africa
programme.desc: Etosha was once a great lake that dried up and now only fills with water seasonally during the summer rains. Once the Etosha pan is full of water, a myriad of water birds congregate in the shallow lake to breed, most notably Greater and lesser flamingos.

programme.title: Extreme Africa
programme.desc: Follow the course of South Africas Orange river from its origins to where it spills out into the Atlantic Ocean. Along the way we encounter a diverse range of habitats and the creatures they support, from the dry lands of the Richtersveld to the beauty of Augrabies this is the story of the Linear Oasis. We reveal how life is adapted to survive along its course and discover a rich world of plants and animals.

programme.desc: The all-female Hollywood pride have been in exile after being attacked by the four Nomad brothers. But their leader, Ava, decides to lead her family south to the heart of their territory for a showdown with the Nomads.

programme.desc: An Australian family go on an adventure to restore an old hunting ranch in South Africa. Their goal is to rebuild the overgrown habitat, create an eco-tourism ranch, and allow the natural wildlife, including predators, to move back in.

programme.title: Arctic Secrets
programme.desc: The Yukon is a true wilderness, one of the last on Earth. The vast land got its name from its longest river, which the Gwichin, one of the indigenous people of the region, call Yu-kun- ah, or, the great river. Detectives arrived on the scene and began their investigation which brought them across the globe, and ultimately to the door of the Mulhall family. Linda and Charlotte Mullhall, dubbed the Scissor Sisters due to the barbarity of the crime, stabbed and dismembered their mothers partner, Farah Swaleh Noor and dumped his headless body into the canal. The crime horrified yet captivated the nation. This docu-series forensically examines this crime, along with the aftermath that it left in its wake.

programme.title: When I was Your Age
programme.desc: Paul, 10, is a typical little boy. He goes to school, he plays sports, he is secretly in love, he tries to do as little as possible at home, he confuses his parents to get what he wants. And most of all, he would like them to finally understand that hes not a baby anymore and is old enough to do things ON HIS OWN!Except that... he has a strange gift... or curse... As soon as someone says the words, When I was your age... Paul is immediately hurled back to the time when the person he is talking to was 10 years old like he is now. He can shoot back 20, 30...70 years in time! Before mobile phones existed... When boys and girls didnt go to the same school... When there was only one television station... When toilets were at the far end of the yard... In other words, for a boy in 2021: ancient history! So as soon as he hears, When I was your age, gasp, gulp, where and when will he land this time? And in what completely crazy situation?

programme.title: 杏林在線
programme.desc: 夏天是蚊蟲覓食的旺季，到郊外或綠化環境，遇上蜂類，蛇，蜱蟲及恙蟎，可以怎樣及時處理?今集杏林在線，從事保育工作十多年的楊劍煥，過往在野外考察研究時，也試過多次被黃蜂螫嘉道理農場暨植物園嘉道理中國保育保育經理楊劍煥:蜜蜂螫了人，針會留在你的皮膚上面，連同它的毒在那裡，但是胡蜂螫完它便走，不會留針在那裡，我覺得你先冷靜自己，因為其實你在很驚慌的狀態之下，有機會加速一些毒液在你體內運行蜂螫和蛇咬，嚴重可能會有致命風險，拍下蛇的身影，或記下特徵，或能協助醫護人員後續治療威爾斯親王醫院急症科副顧問醫生勞逸曦：當然傷口的位置，可能要簡單的急救處理，清洗，有嚴重過敏反應，有病歷，而有帶到一些急救筆在身的話，其實可以立刻用急救筆，去幫忙減輕嚴重過敏反應辨認到是毒蛇的話，我們可以盡快給血清的話，便減低併發症發生的機會有研究指，蚊可以透過後天學習蚊怕水的氣味，噴蚊怕水還是否有效驅蚊 ? 節目會詳細講解藥劑師則說，使用避蚊胺DEET及派卡瑞丁等成分的蚊怕水，要注意濃度

programme.title: 730 玩返轉

programme.title: 舉頭三尺

programme.title: 區區都有STEM

programme.title: 듀얼
programme.desc: quot살인마 VS 추격자, 똑같이 생긴 두 놈을 쫓아라!quot 나와 모든 것이 똑같은 복제인간이 이 세상에 존재한다면? 그리고 그가행하는 연쇄살인의 범인으로 내가 지목된다면? 모든 기억을 잃고 납치와 살인의 누명을 쓴 복제인간 성준 누명을 벗기 위한 유일한 방법은 이 모든 사건의 진범인 또 다른 복제인간 성훈을 잡는 것. 기억을 잃은 복제인간 VS 절대악 연쇄살인마의 숨 막히는 추격전! 하나뿐인 딸 수연을 납치 당한 강력팀 형사 득천은 기억 속 납치범과 똑같이 생긴 성준을 검거하려는 순간 성준과 똑같이 생긴 남자성훈을 보게 되고, 딸의 치료비 제공을 조건으로 득천에 사건 조작을 제안한 욕망에 찬 검사 조혜는 모든 것을 버리고 딸을 찾아 나선 득천을 추격하기 시작하는데... 인간 복제라는 거대한 비밀에 휘말린 득천과 성준, 그리고 이들이 펼치는 절대악 연쇄살인마와의 목숨을 담보로 한 대결은 박진감 넘치는 추격 스릴러 로서, 빠져들 수 밖에 없는 재미를 선사할 것이다.

programme.title: 더 재킷
programme.desc: 1991년 걸프전에서 머리에 총상을 입고 충격성 기억상실증에 걸린 잭에드리언 브로디. 1년 뒤, 히치하이킹 한 차를 타고 캐나다로 가던 잭은 기억을 잃고 쓰러지고, 며칠 후 깨어난 그는 살인혐의를 받아 법정에 세워진 사실을 알게 된다. 재판 결과 알파인 그로브 정신병원에 보내지게 된 잭. 치료를 위해 약물 주사를 맞고 재킷이 입혀진 채, 시체보관실에 갇히게 된 그는 극심한 공포감으로 또다시 기억을 잃게 된다

programme.title: 가문의 위기
programme.desc: 570만 관객동원의 대박 흥행작. 신현준, 김원희, 탁재훈이 확실하게 웃겨준다. 정준호, 현영 등 코믹 까메오들을 보는 재미도 쏠쏠. 2002년 개봉되어 무려 530만의 관객을 동원했던 lt가문의 영광gt 이후 3년만에 등장하는 속편. 전편이 서울대 출신의 엘리트 사위를 맞이면서 벌어지는 이야기였던 반면, 이번 속편은 서울지검 강력계 검사 며느리를 맞이하면서 벌어지는 여수 조폭 집안의 좌충우돌 소동을 코믹하게 그렸다. 여검사 역에 김원희가, 그녀와 사랑에 빠지는 맏형 역에 신현준이, 그의 두 동생 역에 탁재훈, 임형준이, 그리고 이들 세 형제의 어머니이자 백호파 대모 홍덕자 여사 역에 김수미가 출연한다.

programme.title: 出動重機械 第2季第4集
programme.desc: 本集節目要介紹全世界最龐大的挖泥船達太安號,可伸縮超高拆樓機TUHD60,以及經過改裝的海王直昇機. 巴拿馬運河是長達80公里,將陸地一分為二的水路. 由於現代船舶越來越龐大,運輸量也越來越重,水深僅14米的運河已難以應付. 於是他們將關閉四小時,讓鉸刀吸入式挖泥船達太安號來加深航道. 在荷蘭阿姆斯特丹市中心有一棟破舊的實驗大樓,它的高度對傳統拆樓機來說是遙不可及,而且大樓是蓋在運河正上方,於是超高拆樓機TUHD60即將派上用場,負責把大樓夷為平地又不破壞周圍的建築. 多用途老式直昇機海王已為21世紀戰場完成改裝. 英國皇家海軍突擊隊將進行演習,為上阿富汗戰場做準備.

programme.title: 四驅高手 第2季第10集

Roh tersebut secara tidak sengaja dibebaskan oleh pasangan itu selepas mereka menemui sebuah balang kecil yang terdampar di pantai. Selepas kematian Rose, Darma membawa balang itu bersamanya, tanpa disedari telah membawa roh tersebut ke dalam hidupnya. Terkejut dengan kejadian bunuh diri itu, Darma bekerjasama dengan adik kembar Rose, Seri, untuk menyiasat. Semasa mereka menyiasat, pelbagai kejadian aneh berlaku, menyebabkan keadaan mental Darma semakin merosot dan memberi kesan kepada kerjayanya. Dia pulang ke kampung untuk berehat, tanpa disedari semakin hampir dengan kebenaran. Akhirnya, terungkap bahawa nenek Darma secara tidak sengaja telah mengundang roh yang dikenali sebagai Saka ke dalam rumah mereka, satu roh yang menghantui keturunan pemiliknya selepas kematian.
